steps.name: Given I am on CP Agilelogin Page
When I am going to login to CP with Agile Staff credential
Then I verify that Agile Staff should be login and Dashboard should be open
When I am going to search Agile Candidate
Then I verify Agile Candidate should be display in grid box
And I verify after clicks on candidate detail page should be display
When I am going to search with Representative name for Agile linked candidates
Then I verify Agile Candidate should be display in grid box
And I verify after clicks on candidate detail page should be display
When I filter with Representative name to get linked Agile candidates
Then I verify Agile Candidate should be display in Awaiting review grid box
And I verify when clicks on Representative filter candidate name and detail page should be display
When I filter with Followuptoday name to get linked Agile candidates
Then I verify Agile Candidate should be display in Awaiting review grid box
And I verify when clicks on Followuptoday filter candidate name and detail page should be display
When I filter with Followupsoon name to get linked Agile candidates
Then I verify Agile Candidate should be display in Awaiting review grid box
And I verify when clicks on Followupsoon filter candidate name and detail page should be display
And I verify that user should be logout from Dashboard and redirect to Login page
